item.text: I’ll read the three files once, then make one algorithm-level improvement in `algorithm.py` using a native patch.

The current pass moves only the second relation endpoint, then clamps it, which can leave preferred-distance error unresolved. I’ll add a repair capped at 8 cm per floor object, preserving yaw and accepting it only when total 3D preference error decreases without worsening any floor relation’s hard-distance violation. Diversity and physics margins remain unmeasured.

Modified only `algorithm.py` with a bounded 3D relation repair: floor objects move at most 8 cm, yaw stays unchanged, and repairs require lower preference error without worsening hard-distance violations.

Tests were left to the external controller; physics and diversity gains remain unverified.
